milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the acacia log cluster (centered at spawn-relative [6, 2, 6]) and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. The acacia logs are placed at ~5-7, 0-5, 6-7 relative to spawn, forming a distinctive orange-bark tree. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the logs.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a jungle_door results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The recipe requires 6 jungle planks in a 2x3 pattern on a crafting table, producing 3 jungle doors. The player starts with exactly 6 jungle planks and a crafting table is placed at ~9,0,6. Checking for min_count=1 is sufficient since any jungle_door in inventory proves successful crafting (the item is not in starting inventory).
